title.rendered: Pre-K Program Spots are Still Available!

content.rendered:
We are excited to share that we have opened up additional slots for our PreK programs at Hawks View, Middleton and Ridges! While these three schools host our district PreK classes, any district PreK student is welcome to apply. 

Please visit our District PreK Program webpage for specific details. If you are interested in having your child attend please complete the interest form linked here and we will follow up soon. 

If you have any questions, please contact Amy Gillett, our district Early Learning Coordinator for assistance. 

agillett@sherwood.k12.or.us 

503-825-5087
